text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: —Oh, hey, it's Yukino.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: City-san...! Good morning!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Isn't today race day? The Victoria Mile, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yes! I'm on my way there right now.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: I see. ...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Hey, how've things been... lately?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I'm working hard and full of energy! In my 
last race—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I know her track record. She's in 
great shape. But that's not what I 
meant...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Or not?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...No. Sorry for holding you back.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
No, no! Thanks so much for checkin' in on 
me!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Well then, I'm off!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Take care.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...She really seems okay, but—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Waaah! As expected of the Victoria Mile! 
Every girl here is so gorgeous.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Unlike Classic-exclusive races, everyone 
looks calm and completely fired up!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Yukino Bijin is out! Eee, she's as 
cute as ever!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Still, how should I put it... compared to 
the other girls, she just looks a little 
precarious, doesn't she? Maybe it's 
because of her fresh, rookie vibe?

text_block_list.name: Yukino's Fans A & B
text_block_list.text:
Yukino-chaaaan! You're so cute today 
toooooo!!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Cute, huh.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: "...Yukino. Good luck."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
“—And so, I got to talk with City-san this 
morning, y'know~!”

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Looks like they just finished practice. 
What luck!
choice_data_list: That gave me some power, huh.
That gave me some power, didn't it?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Actually, Mifuyu-chan contacted me last 
night too.

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
"The coach finally gave in to my passion 
and promised to stick with me all the way 
to the ends of hell!"

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
"Practice got super hard, but I'm doing my 
best! I'll catch up to you in no time, 
Yuki-chan!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
—"Even if we're far apart, our hearts are 
together!" ...is what they told me.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"Anyway, all I can do right now is give it 
everything I've got and do my best!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Step by step, one foot at a time! I'll run 
with everything I've got!
